events.title: First ARPANET message sent
events.summary: A UCLA-to-Stanford login attempt failed after two letters — and the internet era began.

narrative.whyChosen: This is the symbolic birth moment of packet-switched networking.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved computers could share resources across distance, which became the internet.
narrative.problemSolved: Expensive mainframes were isolated. Researchers needed a way to share computing power and data remotely.

media.title: Series of tubes
media.caption: Later internet culture often reduced networking to jokes — but the underlying idea started here.
